blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Election lawyer Romulo Macalintal has renewed his call for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to veto the measure postponing the Nov. 2 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE), submitting an urgent supplemental letter-petition to the Office of the President.
